import.too_large: The file is larger than 3 MB.

list.empty_agent: This Thulu version ships no agents in the Workshop.
list.empty_skill: This Thulu version ships no skills in the Workshop.

detail.pick: Pick an item to see what it does and what it brings.
detail.viewer: Only a workspace admin can install.
detail.reserved: That name belongs to an Thulu skill.
detail.disabled: You deleted it from the workspace. Installing it enables it again.

plan.title: Review before installing
plan.lead: This is what will change in the workspace. Where you already have something by the same name, yours is kept unless you pick otherwise.
plan.lead_import: This is what the file brings. Where you already have something by the same name, yours is kept unless you pick otherwise.
plan.edited: You edited it after installing it

action.update: A newer revision ships and you have not changed yours
action.conflict: You already have a different one by this name
action.reserved: The name belongs to an Thulu skill
action.rejected: A file looks like a secret: not imported
action.update_import: The file brings another version and you have not edited it
action.disabled: You had deleted it: installing enables it again

plan.history_kept: The current configuration stays in the agent history

notice.missing_skill: {name} uses skills nothing brings and the workspace lacks: {refs}. It will run without them.
notice.missing_mcp: {name} uses MCP servers this install lacks: {refs}. Those tools will not be in its runs.
notice.unknown_stage: {name} is set up for stages no board has: {refs}. Add them to a board or edit the agent.
notice.image: {name} runs its own image ({refs}). Check that it exists on this install.
notice.image_saas: {name} needs its own image ({refs}) and this install cannot run custom images. Pick "Do not install" to install the rest.
notice.image_import: {name} names a container image ({refs}). An imported agent cannot bring its own image: it comes in without it and runs on its engine's image.
notice.tools_skipped: The file carries manuals for {refs} MCP servers. They are not imported: they belong to the install.
notice.reserved: {name} uses a name reserved for Thulu skills and is left out. To import it, pick "Install as a copy" and give it another name.
notice.kept_skill: {name} will use your {refs}, not the Workshop one. To use the Workshop one, install it as a copy.
notice.kept_skill_import: {name} will use your {refs}, not the one in the file. To use the one in the file, install it as a copy.
notice.secret: {kind} {name} is not imported: {refs} looks like it contains a secret. The rest of the file still installs.

empty_agents: Install ready-made agents from the Workshop, or create your own.
empty_skills: Install ready-made skills from the Workshop, or write your own.
export_all_agents_hint: Download one JSON with every agent in the workspace and the skills they use
export_all_skills_hint: Download one JSON with every skill in the workspace
update_badge_hint: The Workshop has a newer revision and you have not edited it

result.title: Done
